Done in one execution. **Plan** (`out/T2/plan.yaml`, 64 concat + 1 delete + 1 move + 5 asserts): - Head 5 of 128 dims spans indices 640..767, so each projection is rebuilt from two slices. - q/k/v: `concat` of `::[:640, :]` and `::[768:, :]` on `dim: 0`; o_proj: `::[:, :640]` and `::[:, 768:]` on `dim: 1`. - `concat` sources must each resolve to exactly one tensor, so those 64 lines are explicit per layer/projection, written to `tmp..

_proj.weight` (destinations must not pre-exist). - One regex `delete` removes the originals, one regex `move` with backreferences restores all 64 original names. - Required checks are the four layer-0 `shape` asserts plus `count: {of: '.*', is: 114}`, all before `output`. **Result:** `out/T2/model.safetensors`, 114 tensors. Verified independently from the safetensors header: layer 0 and layer 15 q/k/v are `[1920, 2048]`, o_proj is `[2048, 1920]`, all F32. `out/T2/REPORT.md` is written with the self-report fields. `grade.py` isn't present in the sandbox, so I did not run grading.
